name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill 9, injure at least 15, officials say
changes.summary: Kyiv said the strikes had killed four people, and the city's mayor reported 15 people, including two boys aged 13 and 17, were wounded and transported to hospital.

changes.title: Trump Backs Away From Deal to Let Ukraine Build Patriot Missiles
changes.summary: The president of Ukraine had warned that the country was running out of Patriot interceptors, the most reliable weapon it has to shoot down Russian ballistic missiles.

changes.title: How Ukraine Is Making Inroads With MAGA and a Trump Ally, Laura Loomer
changes.summary: Ukraine and its supporters have invested years in trying to undo the skepticism of the country’s war effort harbored by President Trump’s MAGA movement and the president himself.

changes.title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
changes.summary: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.

changes.title: Russian Missiles Kill 9 in Kyiv, Hours After Trump Backs Off Air Defense Pledge
changes.summary: It was the second deadly barrage to hit the Ukrainian capital in two days, as Moscow escalates its attacks in an apparent effort to exploit Ukraine’s dwindling supply of interceptors.

changes.title: News Wrap: Death toll from Japan earthquake rises to 34
changes.summary: In our news wrap Friday, this week's powerful earthquake in Japan has claimed at least 34 lives, a sweltering heat dome descended over much of the West, a Marine Corps fighter jet crashed at Miramar Air Station in California and President Trump says the U.S. has not yet agreed to let Ukraine build Patriot missiles to a.

changes.title: Ukraine drone strikes on Wildberries warehouses hit Russian sellers, consumers
changes.summary: Ukraine's attacks on warehouses of the Russian online retailer Wildberries have hurt small businesses and some consumers.

changes.title: How volunteers with 3D printers make weapons for Ukraine
changes.summary: Last week, Ukrainian President Zelenskyy dismissed his tech-savvy defense minister. That sparked protests among supporters who credit him with helping transform Ukraine's defense capabilities. Special correspondent Simon Ostrovsky and producer Katia Patin report on the technologies and policies that helped drive that t.

changes.title: Ukraine hits Russia's largest online marketplace, hurting small businesses and bringing the war home
changes.summary: The Ukrainian attacks on the sprawling Russian warehouses produced stark images, with massive pillars of black smoke rising above fires that raged at facilities of Wildberries, the country's biggest online retailer and its equivalent of Amazon.

changes.title: Russia and Ukraine Trade Deadly Blows With Missiles and Drones
changes.summary: Ukrainian strikes set fire to warehouses and other sites in Russia, and Russian bombing rocked Ukraine’s capital, as the two countries escalated an air campaign.
